title: Automatic Renewal Settings by Northgate Membership Tier
content:
Each tier of Northgate Memberships fixes whether it may be put on automatic renewal, which payment methods are accepted for it, when the reminder goes out, when the charge is attempted and how a declined charge is retried.

| Tier | Automatic renewal may be switched on | Payment methods accepted | Charge attempted (days after the expiry date) | Reminder email (days before the expiry date) | Retries after a declined charge | Days between retries |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Student Club Membership | No | none | 0 (on the expiry date) | 30 | 3 | 4 |
| Northgate Heroes Club Membership | Yes | Northgate Rewards Visa; Northgate Store Card; other credit card; debit card | 0 (on the expiry date) | 30 | 3 | 4 |
| Northgate Club Membership | Yes | Northgate Rewards Visa; Northgate Store Card; other credit card; debit card | 0 (on the expiry date) | 30 | 3 | 4 |
| Northgate Business Membership | Yes | Northgate Rewards Visa; Northgate Store Card; other credit card | 0 (on the expiry date) | 30 | 3 | 4 |
| Northgate Club Plus Membership | Yes | Northgate Rewards Visa; Northgate Store Card; other credit card; debit card | 0 (on the expiry date) | 30 | 3 | 4 |
| Northgate Business Plus Membership | Yes | Northgate Rewards Visa; Northgate Store Card; other credit card | 0 (on the expiry date) | 30 | 3 | 4 |

## Notes on the settings

- The Student Club tier cannot be put on automatic renewal and accepts no payment method for it.
- The consumer tiers that allow automatic renewal accept four payment methods, including a debit card; the two business tiers accept three and do not accept a debit card.
- A charge offset of 0 days means the automatic renewal charge is attempted on the expiry date itself.
- Retry counts and spacing are the same on every tier: 3 retries after a declined charge, 4 calendar days apart.

## Hypothetical timeline (derived from the table)

For a Club membership with automatic renewal on and an expiry date falling on a day D: the reminder email is sent 30 days before D; the charge is attempted on D; if it is declined, the 3 retries fall 4, 8 and 12 calendar days after D.
